faq.title: Clarity for decision-makers. Context for operators.

items.question: Does yapt. replace all the tools we already use?
items.answer: The assessment defines what makes sense to bring into yapt. and what needs to remain connected. Integrations depend on available systems, APIs and access; the aim is to maintain operational continuity with the necessary data.

items.question: Do we need to start with every scenario?
items.answer: We can prioritize one bottleneck and define a first scenario with clear indicators. Further development considers the process, data readiness, integrations and the team that will operate it.

items.question: How does artificial intelligence help with revenue attribution?
items.answer: yapt. connects campaigns, sources, leads, conversations and sales to support investment analysis. Attributed revenue and return must be read with a defined period and attribution criteria, also recognizing sales with no identified source. The Conversion Hub sends configured events to connected platforms to support optimization.

items.question: Does AI make every decision on its own?
items.answer: Configuration defines the criteria, tools and permitted actions. Copilots support the team with summaries and suggestions; agents can perform configured tasks. Permissions, review and testing are part of preparation.

items.question: How do multichannel campaigns and marketing automation work?
items.answer: Sequences connect WhatsApp and email to maintain communication and nurture leads. Other campaign channels, such as SMS and RCS, depend on availability and subscription. Events, conditions and integrations define how each scenario works; the assessment confirms the appropriate channels and capabilities.

items.question: Does content generation automatically publish to social media?
items.answer: The team can prepare and review content for blogs, LinkedIn and Instagram using the selected brand context. Content preparation and internal publication tracking do not mean automatic posting to social media.

items.question: Can we use the platform without hiring specialists?
items.answer: Yes. Your own team can run the platform. If you need help implementing and improving scenarios, you can combine yapt. with specialists. New Way also offers consulting for a defined problem, with or without the platform.
